article.headline: South Africa Petrol Prices Set for Major December Cuts Up to R3.10
article.summary: South African motorists can expect significant petrol price drops in December 2026, driven by lower international oil costs despite changes to fuel tax relief.
article.body:
Motorists are poised for substantial relief at the pumps as petrol prices are projected to fall by as much as R3.10 per litre for 95 Unleaded, according to Central Energy Fund data. While the specific reductions vary, early projections indicate a major turnaround for household transport budgets heading into the final month of the year.

This shift in fuel costs arrives after a year of intense volatility, where petrol prices previously climbed by nearly R10 per litre and diesel by approximately R13. For consumers, the upcoming price adjustment provides a necessary reprieve, though the overall landscape remains subject to external pressures. Analysts caution that rising freight rates for oil shipping and insurance costs continue to impact the broader transport economy.

According to Carmag South Africa, the projected decrease is attributed to falling international petroleum prices and fluctuations in the Rand. Current data from the Central Energy Fund suggests 93 Unleaded may drop by R2.86 while 50ppm diesel could see a 37-cent reduction. However, Carmag notes a potential 28-cent increase for 500ppm diesel, contrasting with broader relief. The Department of Mineral and Petroleum Resources is expected to confirm the final official prices closer to 2 December 2026.

The volatility in fuel costs is further influenced by tax structure adjustments. Treasury’s temporary fuel tax reprieve is scheduled to scale back on 1 December 2026, which will add a surcharge to the final prices. Additionally, government-mandated slate levies implemented in November 2026 continue to factor into the pricing structure. Market observers warn that any escalation in Middle East tensions remains a critical risk factor that could quickly reverse current downward trends in crude oil pricing.

news.title: Ben Shapiro says 'whiff of corruption' surrounds the president he campaigned for
news.og_title: Ben Shapiro says 'whiff of corruption' surrounds the president he campaigned for : NPR's Newsmakers
news.og_desc: Conservative host Ben Shapiro says he is holding to his conservative values in the unstable era of President Trump.The host of The Ben Shapiro Show voted against Trump in 2016 but also campaigned for him in 2024. He’s disappointed in the president’s tariffs, alleged corruption and the execution of the Iran war.“I regret the way the president has performed,” Shapiro tells host Steve Inskeep in this episode of Newsmakers. “I don't regret my vote. I don't have a time machine.”Shapiro says Trump’s aggressive immigration enforcement and the general “whiff of corruption” that surrounds the White House — specifically the Trump family’s crypto company World Liberty Financial — all contributed to the Republican Party’s midterm losses in Congress, governor's mansions and state legislatures.He believes that Republicans have an “uphill road in 2028” and that Vice President Vance isn’t the ideal Republican presidential candidate. He argues that Vance would shrink Trump’s winning 2024 voting bloc of Hispanics, the working class, women and college-educated individuals.Shapiro points to Secretary of State Marco Rubio as a potential 2028 Republican candidate with broader appeal and a larger coalition. But he says many within the current White House will likely be damaged by association.Shapiro also unpacks his new movie, Confession — featuring Rob Lowe and James Franco — and the recent decline in his show’s YouTube subscriptions.Newsmakers is where you'll find NPR's biggest interviews. news.og_title: سياسي / سمو ولي العهد يستقبل قائد القيادة المركزية بالجيش الأمريكي
news.og_desc:
الرياض 09 جمادى الآخرة 1448 هـ الموافق 19 نوفمبر 2026 م واس
    استقبل صاحب السمو الملكي الأمير محمد بن سلمان بن عبدالعزيز آل سعود ولي العهد رئيس مجلس الوزراء، في الرياض اليوم، قائد القيادة المركزية بالجيش الأمريكي الأدميرال براد كوبر والوفد المرافق له.
    وجرى خلال الاستقبال استعراض أوجه العلاقات الثنائية بين البلدين خاصة في المجالات العسكرية، بالإضافة إلى بحث تطورات الأوضاع الإقليمية.
    حضر الاستقبال صاحب السمو الملكي الأمير خالد بن سلمان بن عبدالعزيز وزير الدفاع، ومعالي وزير الدولة عضو مجلس الوزراء مستشار الأمن الوطني الدكتور مساعد بن محمد العيبان، ومعالي رئيس هيئة الأركان العامة قائد القوات المشتركة المكلف الفريق أول ركن فياض بن حامد الرويلي.
